title: SCOG
summary: A Streamlit app that generates synthetic control datasets for experiments using a CTGAN-based synthesizer, comparing synthetic and real data with statistical tests. It uses SDV's single-table CTGANSynthesizer, instantiated with a Metadata schema and trained with fixed epochs, to produce the synthetic data.
